:::{#def-validation-choice}
#### Validation choice

Given candidate [fitting procedures](#def-fitting-procedure) $\candproc{1}, \ldots, \candproc{\ncand}$,
the **validation choice** $\est{\icand}$
is the index of the candidate whose [fitted model](#def-fitted-model),
fitted to the training set $\trainset$,
has the smallest [validation error](#def-validation-error):

$$
\est{\icand} \eqdef \argmin_{\icand} \avgon{\validx}
\lossf{\outvar_{\iobs}, \candpredvalf{\icand}{\predvar_{\iobs}}}.
$$ {#eq-validation-choice}

:::
